summary:
**Planning directory setup**

I'm thinking about creating a directory and files, then listing them afterward. My plan is to use the exec_command to run "mkdir" and "printf". It seems like it could be helpful to track this process with simple bullet points indicating the status of each step. I'll execute the commands to ensure everything works as expected. This approach will keep things organized and clear, so the user knows what’s happening!

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p src
printf 'A' > src/a.txt
printf 'B' > src/b.txt
ls -la src
printf '\\n---\\n'
find src -maxdepth 1 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'printf \"%s: \" \""'$1"; cat "$1"; echo'"' _ {} \\;"
